## Purpose and Entry Points
Presenton is a self-hostable AI presentation generator: users or API clients create, edit, and export PPTX/PDF presentations from prompts and uploaded documents. It runs as a browser-served Docker stack or a desktop Electron app.

Primary entry points: FastAPI application at `servers/fastapi/api/main.py`, Next.js UI at `servers/nextjs/app/page.tsx`, Electron main process at `electron/app/main.ts`, and container startup/build wiring in `start.js`, `Dockerfile`, and `docker-compose.yml`.

## Client Application and Editing Surface
The Next.js App Router application provides onboarding/configuration, upload-to-outline generation, dashboard, template/theme management, and the presentation workspace. It calls FastAPI for generation and persistence, while selected Next.js routes broker local/export-oriented operations.

Key paths:
- `servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/upload/components/UploadPage.tsx`
- `servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/outline/components/OutlinePage.tsx`
- `servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/components/PresentationPage.tsx`

The editable slide surface is a substantial client-side model/rendering boundary, including text, tables, charts, images, selection, layout, and Konva rendering:
- `servers/nextjs/components/slide-editor/model/model.ts`
- `servers/nextjs/components/slide-editor/surface/TemplateV2KonvaSlide.tsx`
- `servers/nextjs/components/slide-editor/state/state.ts`

## API, Authentication, and Lifecycle
FastAPI owns the public `/api/v1` domain, startup lifecycle, middleware, auth, and route composition. PPT routes cover presentation generation and CRUD, slides, outlines, templates, themes, file/font/image/icon operations, provider configuration, and streaming/chat. An MCP server exposes generation to MCP clients outside Electron.

Key paths:
- `servers/fastapi/api/main.py`
- `servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/router.py`
- `servers/fastapi/mcp_server.py`

Authentication is a single instance-admin model, with persisted configuration and session/basic-auth boundaries:
- `servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/router.py`
- `servers/fastapi/utils/simple_auth.py`
- `servers/fastapi/utils/user_config_store.py`

## Generation Pipeline
Generation accepts prompt, optional documents, template, output format, tone, language, and slide count. The backend derives an outline/structure, generates slide content through the selected LLM, obtains supporting images/icons, renders slides through the chosen template system, persists the presentation, and can queue export work.

Core pipeline locations:
- `servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/presentation.py`
- `servers/fastapi/utils/llm_calls/generate_presentation_outlines.py`
- `servers/fastapi/utils/llm_calls/generate_slide_content.py`

Longer-running work and client progress use async-task and SSE-oriented interfaces:
- `servers/fastapi/api/v1/async_tasks/router.py`
- `servers/fastapi/services/export_task_service.py`
- `servers/fastapi/models/sse_response.py`

## Templates, Themes, and Export Boundary
Legacy templates reside under root `templates/`; the newer template-v2 system models layout elements/schema and generates presentation slides. Users can create templates from uploaded PowerPoint files and customize fonts/layouts. Presentation data remains editable through the UI before export.

Key paths:
- `servers/fastapi/templates/v2/generation.py`
- `servers/fastapi/templates/v2/models/elements.py`
- `servers/fastapi/api/v1/ppt/endpoints/template.py`

PPTX/PDF export crosses into bundled browser/runtime tooling and desktop-local handlers:
- `servers/nextjs/app/api/export-presentation/route.ts`
- `servers/nextjs/lib/run-bundled-presentation-export.ts`
- `electron/app/ipc/export_handlers.ts`

## Persistence, Documents, and Memory
SQLAlchemy models and Alembic migrations persist presentations, slides, templates, uploaded fonts/images, async tasks, chat history, and webhook subscriptions. `DATABASE_URL` is configurable; SQLite is the default local fallback. App data is intended to be volume-mounted.

Key paths:
- `servers/fastapi/services/database.py`
- `servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py`
- `servers/fastapi/alembic/versions/00b3c27a13bc_init.py`

Document ingestion/conversion and LiteParse provide uploaded-file grounding. Optional Mem0 uses local Qdrant, SQLite, embeddings, and spaCy for presentation-scoped memory:
- `servers/fastapi/services/documents_loader.py`
- `servers/fastapi/services/liteparse_service.py`
- `servers/fastapi/services/mem0_presentation_memory_service.py`

## External Providers and Deployment
The provider boundary supports OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenAI, Google/Gemini, Vertex, Azure, Bedrock, Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, and others; text generation configuration is centralized separately from image generation and web search.

Key paths:
- `servers/fastapi/utils/llm_provider.py`
- `servers/fastapi/services/image_generation_service.py`
- `servers/fastapi/utils/web_search.py`

Docker packages Python/FastAPI, built Next.js assets, nginx, document tooling, and optional GPU/local-model access. Electron launches local backend/UI processes, exposes controlled IPC, and bundles native/export dependencies:
- `nginx.conf`
- `electron/app/utils/servers.ts`
- `electron/app/ipc/index.ts`
